Subject: Phase 7: Predictive Dialer & Campaign Management
Description:
Implement the predictive dialer and campaign management system.

# High-Level Design (HLD)
- Predictive dialing algorithm (Pacing)
- Campaign management (Start, Stop, Pause, Schedule)
- Lead management and list importing
- Answering Machine Detection (AMD)
- Disposition management

# Architecture Decisions
- Implement the dialer as a separate service or module
- Use a mathematical model for predictive pacing (e.g., Erlang-C based)
- Integrate with Asterisk AMD for filtering non-human calls
- Use Redis for real-time lead queue management

# Deliverables
- packages/backend/src/services/dialer.service.ts
- packages/backend/src/services/campaign.service.ts
- Dialer pacing algorithm implementation
- Campaign management UI

## Inputs

- Current connect rate

## Output
- Number of calls to originate in the next interval

- [ ] Integration with Redis for real-time metric retrieval
